UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and AI assistant preferences for Morvent.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

goal.description: The command or multi-step automation goal requested by the user.

stepsCount.description: Number of executed or planned steps.

aiProvider.description: Model or engine used (e.g., gemini-3.5-flash-lite, Local Artemis).

CloudChatMessage.title: CloudChatMessage
CloudChatMessage.description: Cloud-synced conversation message between the user and Morvent AI.

isUser.description: True if authored by user, false if Morvent AI reply.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when message was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user profile and AI model settings.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Per-user autonomous execution task history synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Per-user synced chat history with Morvent Gemini AI.
